8. **Push.**

   - Run `git -C /work/widgets-pr-42 merge-tree --write-tree origin/main HEAD` again. It exits 0.

9. **Exit check before the watch.**

   - Run `gh run list -R acme/widgets -c 2222… --json databaseId,status,conclusion,workflowName,url`.
   - `ci / test` is pending on 2222… and its run is not completed, so the check is binding and the watch is admitted.
10. **Watch.**
    - Persist `repair.poll_deadline` = now + 15 minutes.
    - Run `gh pr checks 42 -R acme/widgets --watch`, bounded at 15 minutes by the harness timeout.
    - Exact-head CI succeeds.

    - Evidence moved from pending to CI-sufficient, so a fresh claim-check-only helper is dispatched: `subagent({ agent: worker, context: "fresh", async: false, cwd: /work/widgets-pr-42 })`. Its task is `claim check only` and report-only, with assessed head 2222…. It returns `source: ci` and a disposition for the one material claim ("rejects unsigned events": matched).
    - The report binds to the pre-push reviewer's closure lines (N1 resolved).
    - No comment delta exists, so no source re-review runs and no whole-wave review runs after an own push. N2 is never surfaced in this run.
12. **Release the one-shot hold.**
    - The selected work and reconciliation are complete, so clear `repair.wave`.

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After improves on Before by persisting the fix-nits action and N1 payload in repair.wave before any work, treating watch as part of the single authorized iteration rather than a separate Wait course, and keeping the fix-nits checkpoint through a real obstacle render in B instead of an ordinary wait row. The After wording should make the post-push reconciliation include the source re-review of the pushed wave (the Entry conditions N2 on 'if source re-review runs', and the fact expects it), record N2 as an open nit without repairing it, and re-render final with 'fix nits' exposed and course still null. Also tighten the B deliver row: 'resume the retained course' reads as if a standing course exists while the narration says course is null; phrase it as 'select course deliver: watch ci / test for one more window' so the retained one-shot checkpoint is not mistaken for standing nit authority.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: After fixes the watch and the timeout branch: it persists `repair.wave.action: fix-nits`, the N1 payload and pre_wave_head before dispatch, runs a bounded exact-head watch after the push, and in B keeps the one-shot checkpoint through a real obstacle menu with no fabricated completion and no standing nit course, which moves f4 to holds. What still fails is the tail of the iteration: After explicitly states that no source re-review runs after the push because there is no comment delta, so N2 is never discovered, the A menu offers only merge/stop, and the record is not shown as re-exposing fix nits — f2 (iteration must include re-review) and f3 (N2 recorded but not auto-repaired, fix nits offered again) stay failed exactly as in Before. To deliver the Change while keeping every fact, the wording should make the selected one-shot nit iteration unconditional in shape: review → push → watch → post-push source re-review on the pushed head (not gated on comment deltas), with any newly surfaced nit recorded under the still-null course and surfaced as a nit line plus a fresh `fix nits` row on final rather than dispatched; the B branch wording is already correct and should be left as is.
